Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next step: technical deep dive?

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery to confirm we captured priorities correctly: 

- Primary goal: reduce per-call inference latency and predictable tail performance for real-time chat (customer-facing).
- Traffic profile: ~120 QPS average, spikes to ~500 QPS during peak marketing events.
- Data sensitivity: PII in prompts, must stay in VPC/private deployment for production.
- Success metrics: 40% TCO reduction vs current infra, 99th percentile latency < 250ms.

Next step: a 45-minute technical deep dive where we can walk through: workload/seq-length distribution, model variants (float16/quantized), and an initial rollout plan (Dedicated vs Private). I can bring Laura from Platform to cover deployment/architecture and any security questions.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Mon Sep 14 — 09:00–09:45
- Mon Sep 14 — 11:00–11:45
- Tue Sep 15 — 14:00–14:45

If you’re able to lock one of those, please accept the calendar invite I’ll send. If none work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll adjust. For scheduling we’ll need a tighter confirmation than usual because our platform team is booking dedicated setup time — appreciate a calendar accept within 24 hours if possible.

Attached: discovery-notes-20260912.pdf (notes from today).

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom.d@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Hi Priyom —

Sorry — I missed your note yesterday while I was tied up with an exec review. Appreciate the clear recap. The team is very interested in the deep dive; two quick asks before we lock:

1) Can you confirm an attendee list (our security lead may join).
2) We prefer the afternoon slot on Tue 15, but if you need to do it on Mon 14 we can do 11:00–11:45.

Could you send the calendar invite and any prep checklist we should review?

Thanks —

alex.j@stellargo.com | (212) 555-0199

To keep things tight on the calendar (our infra folks are booked), can you confirm one of the two firm options below by accepting the calendar invite within 24 hours? If the invite isn’t accepted we’ll release the slot and propose an alternate to avoid last-minute scramble.

Firm options (PT):
- Mon Sep 14 — 11:00–11:45 (preferred backup to Tue)

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/evt/abc123

If you can accept the invite now I’ll lock the infra slot and send a brief agenda. Otherwise reply with which slot to hold and I’ll tentatively reserve for 24 hours.

Best,
Priyom
